why_we_use_it: The payment amount. Fraudsters often test with small amounts then spend big.
Log of the amount. Squashes a very skewed range so models cope better.
Amount divided by this card's usual spend. Catches out-of-character payments.
The card's normal spending level, learned from training data only.
How often the shop appears. Unknown shops carry more risk.
Age at the time of payment, worked out from date of birth.
Hour of the day. Fraud peaks at night.
Day of the week, to capture weekly habits.
1 if between 10pm and 4am, when the real owner is usually asleep.
Distance from home to the shop, using the haversine formula.
Size of the customer's city, a rough proxy for urban or rural.
Log of city size, because the raw values are very skewed.
One yes/no column per purchase category (one-hot encoding).
